shared_elements: low-relief carved linear detail on a stone slab or block
stylised head with elaborate headdress or hair mass
incised circular/disc motif on the body area
justification: Both depict a single dominant anthropomorphic figure carved in relief with a large head, elaborate headdress-like mass and incised detailing including circular motifs on the chest area, which is a fairly generic correspondence. B shows a bearded, winged figure in profile with large feathered wings, a raised arm holding an object and finely combed hair and feather patterning, whereas A is a blocky frontal figure with schematic looped and disc ornaments and no wings, profile or held attribute, so the specific iconography and rendering conventions differ sharply.
